name: web-arch
title: Archived-Page Diff Viewer
description: See how a web page — a privacy policy or terms of service — has quietly changed over time. Finds the points where the wording actually changed and explains each in plain language. A sub-brand of knowless, called redline.
audience: Anyone who wants to know what changed in a document they rarely re-read — privacy policies, terms of service, and similar legal or policy pages.
useCases: A user pastes a company’s privacy-policy URL and sees the most recent change first — what was added, removed, or reworded
A journalist tracks how a platform’s terms of service shifted over the last two years, ranked worst-first
Someone checks a claim against the record — what a page said before versus what it says now, both sourced to real archived captures
A reader turns on the plain-language layer to get a one-line summary and a significance score for each change

dataPrivacy.storage: No account. Lookups run against the public Wayback Machine; results are cached in the browser session only.
dataPrivacy.thirdParty: Internet Archive Wayback Machine for captures; an optional LLM (via OpenRouter, server-side) for the plain-language summaries.
